note: Pre-migration asset baseline. AssetMapper serves each file separately over the importmap; sizes are the uncompressed bytes of the tracked sources (the compiled TypeScript lives in var/typescript inside the container). Lighthouse was not run (no lighthouse binary on the host); LCP/TTI baseline is 'Unknown' and DEV-8 replaces the relative threshold with an absolute budget. Runtime transfer was measured on the DEV image (sensiolabs typescript-bundle dev output with inline source maps, ~1 MB per controller); production compiles with asset-map:compile and is much smaller. Treat runtime_transfer as an upper bound, and sources_bytes (12 files, ~130 kB uncompressed TS+CSS) as the honest baseline.
method: wc -c on tracked sources at 91f8f85; runtime transfer measured with curl against the oracle stack
